nodes.label: CI workflow check job (ci.yml)
nodes.rationale: npm ci, typecheck, lint, test on windows-latest with Node 24; must be green before merging since branch protection is unavailable on the private repo.

nodes.label: Conventional Commits and branch naming
nodes.rationale: type(scope): subject under 72 chars; branches <type>/<short-kebab-description>; conventional default chosen by the user.

nodes.label: test-runner
nodes.rationale: Runs typecheck and npm test and returns only failures plus a summary so long output stays out of the caller context; never edits.

nodes.label: Default git authorization (commit, push, PR, merge)
nodes.norm_label: default git authorization (commit, push, pr, merge)
nodes.rationale: Commit, push of work branch, PR and merge once every gate passes are pre-authorized; cleanup, release and continue need explicit authorization; merge_mode: ask removes merge from defaults.

nodes.label: Documentation-only changes skip checks
nodes.rationale: typecheck, lint and test are skipped when only Markdown, docs/ or .claude agent/skill/param files change; PR must state the skip.

nodes.label: Conventional Commits message format
nodes.rationale: type(scope)!: imperative summary under 72 chars; enables automatic semver bumps and readable squash-merge history.

nodes.label: Never skip hooks, never amend
nodes.rationale: A failed hook means the commit did not happen; fix the cause and make a new commit instead of bypassing verification or amending.

nodes.label: Staged-diff secret check
nodes.rationale: Never stage .env, *.pem, *.key, credentials files; grep the staged diff for token prefixes before committing.

nodes.label: Verified push (remote, branch, commit range)
nodes.rationale: Push only when authorized and after checking remote, branch and that only intended commits are ahead; never push main directly; never force-push.

nodes.label: Merge gates (checks pass, MERGEABLE and CLEAN, review decision, complete PR body)
nodes.norm_label: merge gates (checks pass, mergeable and clean, review decision, complete pr body)
nodes.rationale: Without branch protection these gates are the only protection, so they are applied strictly; admin override is never used.

nodes.label: Squash merge with match-head-commit and tip-checked branch deletion
nodes.norm_label: squash merge with match-head-commit and tip-checked branch deletion
nodes.rationale: match-head-commit fails the merge if someone pushed after the check; the tip check makes local branch deletion safe after a squash merge.

nodes.label: Stacked PRs (avoided)
nodes.rationale: Child branches need rebase onto the default branch after the parent squash merge plus a force push, which the agent never does, so they are returned as proposals.

nodes.label: PR body sections (Summary, Why, Changes, Architecture, Testing, Validation, Known limitations, Revision)
nodes.norm_label: pr body sections (summary, why, changes, architecture, testing, validation, known limitations, revision)
nodes.rationale: Missing inputs are written as "Not provided"; test results are never invented.

nodes.label: Semver bump derived from Conventional Commits
nodes.norm_label: semver bump derived from conventional commits
nodes.rationale: Breaking change gives major (minor while 0.x), feat gives minor, anything else patch.

nodes.label: Test conventions (makeFixture, fake CLI, raw(), mocked fetch)
nodes.norm_label: test conventions (makefixture, fake cli, raw(), mocked fetch)

nodes.label: SVG allowlist check (checkSvg) for skin artwork
nodes.norm_label: svg allowlist check (checksvg) for skin artwork

nodes.label: CI job check (typecheck, lint, test on windows-latest, Node 24)
nodes.norm_label: ci job check (typecheck, lint, test on windows-latest, node 24)

nodes.label: ESLint readability rules (id-length, id-denylist, naming-convention, max-lines)
nodes.norm_label: eslint readability rules (id-length, id-denylist, naming-convention, max-lines)

nodes.label: Naming rules (full words, boolean questions, units in names)
nodes.norm_label: naming rules (full words, boolean questions, units in names)

nodes.label: Fixed error strings to browser
nodes.rationale: JSON parse errors can quote secrets.

nodes.label: OAuth token handling rule (read only in pollLive, never refresh)
nodes.norm_label: oauth token handling rule (read only in polllive, never refresh)
nodes.rationale: Refreshing rotates the token and can log Claude Code out; never log or return it.

nodes.label: Usage shown in tokens only, no cost estimates
nodes.norm_label: usage shown in tokens only, no cost estimates
nodes.rationale: User preference.

nodes.label: Tolerate mid-write session JSON (retry next tick)
nodes.norm_label: tolerate mid-write session json (retry next tick)

nodes.label: TypeScript constraints (erasableSyntaxOnly, .ts import extensions, import type)
nodes.norm_label: typescript constraints (erasablesyntaxonly, .ts import extensions, import type)
nodes.rationale: Node strips types natively, so no enum/namespace/parameter properties.

nodes.label: What a cleanup may not change
nodes.norm_label: what a cleanup may not change
nodes.rationale: Cleanups preserve behaviour; moves via git mv in own PR so git log --follow works.

nodes.label: Pure .logic.ts vs DOM .view.ts split
nodes.rationale: Keeps pure logic testable with node:test.

nodes.label: frontend-tester
nodes.rationale: Playwright tester; may install Playwright and start the local dev server; never interactive modes, never production, never changes app code to pass tests.

nodes.label: Test failure cause classification (locator, timing, test logic, isolation, environment, app bug)
nodes.norm_label: test failure cause classification (locator, timing, test logic, isolation, environment, app bug)
nodes.rationale: Classifying the cause decides whether to fix the test or report an app bug; app code is never changed to make a test pass.

nodes.label: No interactive Playwright modes (debug, ui, headed, show-report)
nodes.norm_label: no interactive playwright modes (debug, ui, headed, show-report)
nodes.rationale: Interactive modes wait for a person and hang an unattended agent.

nodes.label: Web-first retrying assertions instead of waitForTimeout
nodes.norm_label: web-first retrying assertions instead of waitfortimeout
nodes.rationale: Auto-retrying expect() assertions remove timing flakiness without fixed sleeps.

nodes.label: Prove fix with many repeated runs
nodes.norm_label: prove fix with many repeated runs
nodes.rationale: Compare failure rate before and after over 20-50 repetitions alone, in suite and shuffled.

nodes.label: Fix flaky root cause, no blind retries or sleeps
nodes.norm_label: fix flaky root cause, no blind retries or sleeps
nodes.rationale: Retries, longer sleeps, skips and loosened assertions hide flakiness; isolate state, await async work, control time and randomness.

nodes.label: App reachability order (webServer config, running baseURL, start dev server)
nodes.norm_label: app reachability order (webserver config, running baseurl, start dev server)
nodes.rationale: Agent stops exactly the server it started and reports missing prerequisites rather than guessing.

nodes.label: Non-interactive playwright.config with webServer and html reporter open: never
nodes.norm_label: non-interactive playwright.config with webserver and html reporter open: never
nodes.rationale: The html reporter default opens a report server after failures and blocks unattended agents.

nodes.label: Locator priority (data-testid, getByRole, getByText, getByLabel)
nodes.rationale: Avoid CSS selectors tied to DOM structure or styling.

nodes.label: Sensitive areas (auth, server, claude-cli, limits, tls, client rendering)
nodes.norm_label: sensitive areas (auth, server, claude-cli, limits, tls, client rendering)

nodes.label: Project parameters (project-params.md)
nodes.rationale: Generated by /project-setup:install and read by the toolkit agents; each agent reads its own section.

nodes.label: docs parameters section
nodes.rationale: States doc_locations as CLAUDE.md with no docs/ yet, which may be stale given docs/architecture.md and docs/code-style.md exist.

nodes.label: playwright parameters section
nodes.rationale: Tests in tests/e2e named *.spec.ts to keep apart from node:test; webServer env points at a temp fixture with DASHBOARD_LIVE_USAGE=0 and DASHBOARD_COMMANDS=0.

nodes.label: Test isolation via temp-dir fixtures and fakes (makeFixture, fake-claude.mjs)
nodes.norm_label: test isolation via temp-dir fixtures and fakes (makefixture, fake-claude.mjs)
nodes.rationale: Tests never touch real user files or network: globalThis.fetch mocked, Claude CLI replaced by tests/fake-claude.mjs.

nodes.label: Project documentation rules and per-change records
nodes.norm_label: project documentation rules and per-change records
nodes.rationale: Change docs only; never change code to make a document true; report code/doc mismatches.

nodes.label: Document types (README, how-to, reference, explanation)
nodes.rationale: One document, one type; link between them instead of mixing.

nodes.label: Every documented command verified by running it or marked unverified
nodes.norm_label: every documented command verified by running it or marked unverified

nodes.label: Token usage dedup by message.id + requestId
nodes.norm_label: token usage dedup by message.id + requestid

nodes.label: Transcript JSONL files and subagent transcripts
nodes.norm_label: transcript jsonl files and subagent transcripts

nodes.label: Root skin scene (Eywa / Tree of Souls)
nodes.norm_label: root skin scene (eywa / tree of souls)
nodes.rationale: Night-forest artwork served from /root/*.svg; only fixed asset paths, sizes/positions/timings live in _skin-root.scss so there are no inline styles; loaded lazily only when the Root skin is active.

nodes.label: Seed of Eywa sprite (halo + strand rig + body)
nodes.norm_label: seed of eywa sprite (halo + strand rig + body)
nodes.rationale: Same small SVG files reused for every floating seed so the browser caches them.

nodes.label: limbs.svg (dark trunk and limb silhouette, limbFade gradient)
nodes.norm_label: limbs.svg (dark trunk and limb silhouette, limbfade gradient)

nodes.label: seed-body.svg (glowing seed body with halo ellipse)
nodes.norm_label: seed-body.svg (glowing seed body with halo ellipse)

nodes.label: architect-reviewer
nodes.rationale: Reviews designs at macro level; read-only for source, Write only for ADRs when asked; judges against stated goals and flags over-engineering.

nodes.label: code-reviewer (archived VoltAgent version)
nodes.rationale: Generic VoltAgent reviewer with checklists (coverage > 80%, complexity < 10); superseded by the read-only toolkit code-reviewer that reviews against project rules.

nodes.label: node-specialist (archived VoltAgent version)
nodes.rationale: Broad Node backend builder (Express, NestJS, ORMs); superseded by the measurement-driven runtime specialist.

nodes.label: test-automator (archived VoltAgent version)
nodes.rationale: Generic test-automation framework builder incl. UI/mobile; superseded by the below-browser test-automator using the project runner.

nodes.label: typescript-pro (archived VoltAgent version)
nodes.rationale: Generic TS expert (tRPC, frameworks, const enums); superseded by a version honouring project strictness and no-behaviour-change rules.

nodes.label: frontend-developer
nodes.rationale: VoltAgent React/Vue/Angular agent whose description was adapted to cover this project's vanilla TypeScript and SCSS client.

nodes.label: security-auditor
nodes.rationale: Read-only (Read, Grep, Glob) VoltAgent auditor; run after changes to auth, request checks, claude-cli.ts, limits.ts, static handler or client rendering.

nodes.label: Context manager query protocol (VoltAgent)
nodes.rationale: VoltAgent agents start by sending a JSON get_*_context request to a context-manager agent; no such agent exists in this project.

nodes.label: ADR template (Context, Options, Decision, Consequences)
nodes.rationale: Records rejected options honestly; accepted records are never edited, only superseded, with sequential numbering.

nodes.label: Design review dimensions (boundaries, coupling, data ownership, scalability, failure, security, tech fit)
nodes.norm_label: design review dimensions (boundaries, coupling, data ownership, scalability, failure, security, tech fit)
nodes.rationale: Scalability is judged only against stated numbers; no invented scale.

nodes.label: Referrer-Policy same-origin
nodes.rationale: no-referrer makes browsers send Origin: null on form POSTs and breaks login.

nodes.label: qrcode-generator (bundled client devDependency)
nodes.rationale: Added with user approval (team-hq decision 0003) for the QR pairing code; bundled by esbuild into app.js so nothing new at server runtime.

nodes.label: No server runtime dependencies policy
nodes.rationale: Server keeps zero runtime dependencies; only dev tools, eslint tooling (user-approved T-046) and bundled qrcode-generator allowed; anything else needs user approval.

nodes.label: Install script review
nodes.rationale: preinstall/install/postinstall scripts can download or execute code; read them and compare with the project install-script policy.

nodes.label: Read-only dependency audit
nodes.rationale: Audit never changes package.json, lockfiles or installs anything.

nodes.label: Intent-preserving conflict resolution
nodes.rationale: Combine compatible changes; when truly conflicting keep the newer intent and report what was dropped; ask when business logic is ambiguous.

nodes.label: Lockfile changed only by the package manager
nodes.norm_label: lockfile changed only by the package manager

nodes.label: One package or coherent group per upgrade step with rollback
nodes.norm_label: one package or coherent group per upgrade step with rollback
nodes.rationale: Never upgrade on a red baseline; verify lint, tests and build after each step; no forced installs or legacy peer deps.

nodes.label: Severity-ranked review findings (blocker, major, minor)
nodes.rationale: Each finding carries file, line, concrete failure scenario and a minimal fix; taste and linter-enforced issues are excluded.

nodes.label: Measured baseline and re-measure per change
nodes.norm_label: measured baseline and re-measure per change
nodes.rationale: Only measured numbers are reported; a change is kept only if the numbers moved.

nodes.label: Node performance suspects (blocked event loop, slow I/O, unbounded concurrency, buffering, leaks, slow startup)
nodes.norm_label: node performance suspects (blocked event loop, slow i/o, unbounded concurrency, buffering, leaks, slow startup)

nodes.label: execFile/spawn with argument arrays, never shell: true
nodes.norm_label: execfile/spawn with argument arrays, never shell: true
nodes.rationale: shell: true with untrusted input is command injection.

nodes.label: Process lifecycle and graceful shutdown (SIGTERM/SIGINT, close servers, unref timers)
nodes.norm_label: process lifecycle and graceful shutdown (sigterm/sigint, close servers, unref timers)

nodes.label: stream.pipeline for error propagation and backpressure
nodes.norm_label: stream.pipeline for error propagation and backpressure

nodes.label: Security findings ranked by exploitability and impact
nodes.norm_label: security findings ranked by exploitability and impact
nodes.rationale: Never include a real secret in a report; a static review cannot prove absence of vulnerabilities.

nodes.label: Trust boundary mapping (untrusted input to sinks)
nodes.norm_label: trust boundary mapping (untrusted input to sinks)
nodes.rationale: Follow each input to every place it ends up: responses, logs, queries, commands, filesystem.

nodes.label: Strand slice rig (11 rotated seed strands)
nodes.norm_label: strand slice rig (11 rotated seed strands)
nodes.rationale: Each seed-N.svg is one curved glowing filament (shared gradients f/b) from the centre (50,48) to a tip; rotated slices form the dandelion-like pappus.

nodes.label: code-reviewer
nodes.rationale: Read-only reviewer: severity-ranked findings with file, line and failure scenario; no edits, no git state changes, never echoes secrets.

nodes.label: dependency-manager
nodes.rationale: Audit is read-only; upgrades only when asked, one package at a time, no --force, no hand-edited lockfiles, install scripts read before approval.

nodes.label: documentation-engineer
nodes.rationale: Writes only verified documentation, changes doc files only and reports code/doc mismatches instead of fixing code.

nodes.label: node-specialist
nodes.rationale: Diagnoses from measurements; profiles and heap snapshots stay out of the repo; execFile/spawn with argument arrays only.

nodes.label: test-automator
nodes.rationale: Below-browser tests with the project runner; never live services; never claims results it did not see; placeholder npm test is not a pass.

nodes.label: typescript-pro
nodes.rationale: No any/@ts-ignore without reason, no runtime behaviour change in typing tasks, never loosens strictness, no new dependencies unless asked.

nodes.label: Handoffs protocol
nodes.rationale: Agents never depend on another agent; out-of-scope work becomes a Handoffs entry (to, why, task, context, needs authorization) routed by the main session.

nodes.label: Project procedures (sha256 drift check)
nodes.rationale: Agents read procedures listed in their project-params section; a changed source hash means the procedure is stale and the source document wins.

nodes.label: Consults protocol (read-only, max two)
nodes.rationale: Agents may ask another listed agent for read-only help via the Agent tool, at most two per task, passing no authorization; otherwise fall back to a handoff.

nodes.label: Forbidden git actions (never, even if asked)
nodes.norm_label: forbidden git actions (never, even if asked)
nodes.rationale: No force-push, history rewrite, --no-verify, gh pr merge --admin, hard reset on dirty tree or GitHub settings changes; restacking stacked PRs is returned as a proposal.

nodes.label: Devices panel with token and QR (#devices)
nodes.norm_label: devices panel with token and qr (#devices)

nodes.label: .dashboard/ secrets folder (devices.json, alerts.json, TLS keys, commands.log)
nodes.norm_label: .dashboard/ secrets folder (devices.json, alerts.json, tls keys, commands.log)

nodes.label: Loopback exemption (pc device)
nodes.rationale: Local code execution equals LAN remote execution; never expose via proxy/tunnel (decision 0003).

nodes.label: QR pairing two-step flow (GET /pair peek, POST /pair spend)
nodes.norm_label: qr pairing two-step flow (get /pair peek, post /pair spend)
nodes.rationale: Two steps so link previews cannot spend the code; client navigates itself since a cross-app 303 would not carry the SameSite=Strict cookie.

nodes.label: Sliding cookie sessions (7 days, max 90, 10 per device)
nodes.norm_label: sliding cookie sessions (7 days, max 90, 10 per device)

nodes.label: Loopback Host header guard (DNS-rebinding)
nodes.rationale: Localhost mode has no login, so it must only answer loopback Host headers.

nodes.label: server.ts request checks (Host guard, Sec-Fetch-Site, Origin, X-Dashboard, path traversal, security headers)
nodes.norm_label: server.ts request checks (host guard, sec-fetch-site, origin, x-dashboard, path traversal, security headers)

nodes.label: Client XSS rules (esc(), data-tip via textContent, no inline scripts)
nodes.norm_label: client xss rules (esc(), data-tip via textcontent, no inline scripts)
nodes.rationale: Attribute values come back entity-decoded, so tooltips must use textContent.

nodes.label: Permission mode allowlist (plan, default, acceptEdits, auto)
nodes.norm_label: permission mode allowlist (plan, default, acceptedits, auto)
nodes.rationale: bypassPermissions and dontAsk are never allowed.

nodes.label: Self-hosted fonts with OFL licences
nodes.rationale: CSP default-src 'self' blocks Google Fonts; never relax the CSP.

nodes.label: Skins (Classic, Co-pilot, Root) swapping CSS tokens
nodes.norm_label: skins (classic, co-pilot, root) swapping css tokens

nodes.label: No inline styles in new client code
nodes.norm_label: no inline styles in new client code

nodes.label: Animations always run (no prefers-reduced-motion)
nodes.rationale: Windows Animation effects is off on this PC, which froze every animation.

nodes.label: Project colours by alphabetical name
nodes.rationale: A filter must not recolor projects that stay visible.

nodes.label: LAN mode (HTTPS + login, --lan / DASHBOARD_HOST)
nodes.rationale: Never bind beyond loopback without auth.

nodes.label: Claude CLI binary lookup order
nodes.rationale: execFile cannot run .cmd shims, so only native binaries are used.

nodes.label: Model summaries via claude -p haiku (stdin excerpt, no tools)
nodes.norm_label: model summaries via claude -p haiku (stdin excerpt, no tools)
nodes.rationale: Transcript goes on stdin as data, never in argv; failures fall back to recap.

nodes.label: CLI workspace trust (needsTrust)
nodes.rationale: Trust only comes from running claude interactively; never edit .claude.json.

nodes.label: Command execution rules (execFile arg arrays, no shell, audit, max 4 processes)
nodes.norm_label: command execution rules (execfile arg arrays, no shell, audit, max 4 processes)

nodes.label: Prefix for prompts starting with "-"
nodes.rationale: So prompts cannot be parsed as CLI flags.

nodes.label: Dashboard as remote-execution surface
nodes.rationale: Anyone past the login can make Claude act on this PC, so auth and command rules are strict.

nodes.label: Advisories ranked by real risk (reachability, prod vs dev)
nodes.norm_label: advisories ranked by real risk (reachability, prod vs dev)
nodes.rationale: Raw vulnerability counts mislead; judge severity, direct vs transitive path, and whether the vulnerable code path is actually used.

nodes.label: Coverage gaps ranked by business risk
nodes.norm_label: coverage gaps ranked by business risk
nodes.rationale: Percentages mislead; a 100% file with weak assertions is worse than an honestly untested file. Rank critical/important/low.

nodes.label: Arrange-act-assert, one behavior per test
nodes.rationale: Test the public interface, not private details or call counts that break on harmless refactors.

nodes.label: Reproduce bugs with a failing test first
nodes.norm_label: reproduce bugs with a failing test first

nodes.label: Mock external services at module boundaries, no live services
nodes.norm_label: mock external services at module boundaries, no live services
nodes.rationale: Tests never use live databases, payment providers or mail servers.

nodes.label: Gradual strictness raising (noImplicitAny, strictNullChecks, strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess)
nodes.norm_label: gradual strictness raising (noimplicitany, strictnullchecks, strict, nouncheckedindexedaccess)
nodes.rationale: Enabling strict all at once yields hundreds of errors; one flag at a time keeps commit-sized steps.

nodes.label: Leaves-up per-module JS to TS conversion
nodes.norm_label: leaves-up per-module js to ts conversion
nodes.rationale: Converting modules that import nothing first keeps each step small and verifiable; behavior must not change.

nodes.label: Discriminated unions with exhaustiveness checks
nodes.rationale: Makes impossible states unrepresentable.

nodes.label: Avoid any, double casts, non-null assertions and ts-ignore; ts-expect-error with reason
nodes.norm_label: avoid any, double casts, non-null assertions and ts-ignore; ts-expect-error with reason

nodes.label: unknown and narrowing at boundaries, no unchecked casts
nodes.norm_label: unknown and narrowing at boundaries, no unchecked casts
nodes.rationale: A cast on external data is a promise the compiler cannot check.

nodes.label: In-place DOM patching (patchHtml, data-key)
nodes.rationale: Keeps focus, selection, scroll and animations; skips closed popups to keep idle CPU low.

nodes.label: CPU after F-004 (230235b: 0.16% / 0.10%)
nodes.rationale: Drop comes from T-037 skipping unchanged sections and closed popups.

nodes.label: CPU measurement via CDP TaskDuration (headless Chrome/Edge)
nodes.norm_label: cpu measurement via cdp taskduration (headless chrome/edge)

nodes.label: Performance: CPU of an open dashboard tab (docs/perf.md)
nodes.norm_label: performance: cpu of an open dashboard tab (docs/perf.md)

nodes.label: LEGACY_FILES exemption list (empty, may only shrink)
nodes.norm_label: legacy_files exemption list (empty, may only shrink)

nodes.label: Tree of Souls layer stack (glow + 4 shimmer layers)
nodes.norm_label: tree of souls layer stack (glow + 4 shimmer layers)
nodes.rationale: Four dashed willow-strand layers sharing the lavender 'wlg' gradient are stacked over a glow layer for a shimmering, swaying tree; the glow is reused for the water reflection.

nodes.label: tree-glow.svg (lavender glow underlay of tree strands)
nodes.norm_label: tree-glow.svg (lavender glow underlay of tree strands)
